breakdown.description: It asks for the subsurface carbon content to reach 1.10 wt% C even though the surface is held at only 0.90 wt% C. A concentration inside the solid cannot exceed the imposed constant surface concentration in this setup.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the physically impossible target carbon content of 1.10 wt% C, which cannot exceed the imposed surface concentration of 0.90 wt% C. The ground truth corrects this to 0.60 wt% C. The agent failed to identify or fix this error, instead proceeding with the erroneous value and computing a result based on it.
